summary: Frontend-only regression + acceptance test for the START-OF-RUN INITIALIZATION fix (gameReady gating), warm-up section, and improved visual charge compression. Tested at 390x844 on public EXPO_BACKEND_URL. ALL primary acceptance criteria PASS across 10 consecutive fresh runs (5 full page reloads + 5 Game Over -> Play Again cycles). (1) INITIALIZATION: In every one of 10 runs the starting tower rendered at the SAME on-screen position (screen x=44.136, w=99.2 -> world x=0, w=160 through cameraZoom=0.62), with the blob visibly resting on its top cap (confirmed by 5+ screenshots covering reload#1, reload#5, and mid-charge states). The debug overlay was live on the FIRST idle frame in every run (charge=0, vx/vy=0, real next dist/width values). At least 4-6 platforms were visible on the first idle frame (starting + next + next+1 always present) — no run started with the blob floating or with the starting tower missing. (2) STARTING TOWER NOT RANDOMISED: unique starting-tower (x,w) tuple set across 10 runs = {(44,99)} — identical every run. (3) WARM-UP: first 3 upcoming towers on every run had widths corresponding to WIDE (138-152) or MEDIUM (96-118) buckets and gap distances in the gapEarly + 30 range (short/medium); no NARROW towers appeared before id 6; height diffs stayed within the +/-24 warm-up cap. A 700ms medium hold reliably cleared and scored (0 -> 3), proving warm-up is comfortably reachable with a normal hold. (4) RANDOM MAPS DIFFER: 10/10 UNIQUE (next_dist, next_width) signatures observed across the 10 runs: [(205,105),(215,148),(227,144),(224,145),(208,141),(219,117),(201,113),(219,118),(214,144),(214,150)] — mulberry32 seed correctly redrawn per initWorld(). (5) CHARGE TIMING: hold-without-release samples: @~1.0s = 45% (spec 40-55% -> PASS), @~2.0s = 97% (essentially at cap, within 1.8-2.2s target -> PASS), @~2.6s = 100% capped and no overflow (PASS). (6) IMMEDIATE VISUAL COMPRESSION: blob dims measured live from the DOM — idle 28.5x28.5, @0.3s 31.24x24.83 (already ~13% taller-then-shorter and 9.5% wider), @1.2s 34.35x20.61 (~28% shorter, ~20% wider). Compression is present from the very first frames of the hold AND is visibly larger at a longer hold — matches the new eased curve 0.14 + 0.86*c^0.7. (7) NO CAMERA JUMP ON CHARGE: idle vs 300ms-into-hold per-tower screen-x deltas = [0,0,0,0,0,0] — pixel-identical framing, only the blob squashes. (8) REGRESSION: 700ms-hold jump lands and score increments (0 -> 3, includes a perfect bonus), FPS pinned at 60 throughout every sampled interval, no React Native red screen, no shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings in console, and the game-over/play-again/best flow works instantly. No Expo/React Native deprecations detected.
critical_code_review_comments: gameReady gate in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx correctly wraps the entire {world + Pressable + HUD + debug + game-over} tree, so no partially-initialised frame or dead touch surface is ever rendered. useEffect runs initWorld() only when W>0 && H>0 && !gameReady, then flips gameReady=true — matches the iteration spec.

initWorld() pre-populates enough platforms to cover the viewport + spawnAhead and then guarantees >=3 platforms via a second while-loop — this defends against small viewports where the first loop would exit with only [first]. This is the crux of the init fix and it is implemented correctly.

First platform is hard-coded {id:0, x:0, topY:0, width:160, cat:0} — WIDE and at world-origin, so its screen position is deterministic across runs; only upcoming towers use the (freshly-seeded) rng. Verified empirically: 10/10 runs = same starting (screen x, w).

Warm-up branch in makeNextPlatform (warm = id <= CONFIG.warmupTowers=3): forces category weights to {wide:0.62, med:0.38, narrow:0}, clamps gap to gapEarly.min .. gapEarly.min+30, and caps heightVar at 24. Combined with noNarrowBeforeId=6 the first 3 upcoming towers are guaranteed comfortable. Correct.
maxChargeDuration=2.0 with charge accumulator `charge = min(1, charge + dt/2.0)` produces linear 50%@1s and 100%@2s — matches spec and matches measured overlay (45%@~1.0s, 97%@~2.0s).

Visual charge curve uses eased = 0.14 + 0.86*pow(c,0.7). Because eased(0)=0.14 the blob immediately snaps to ~14% of the max squash on touch-down (visible in 0.3s screenshot), and grows quickly toward 1.0 as c grows — decouples visual read from charge-timer linearity as intended.

Camera snap in initWorld() computes camReveal/camRest/camFwd synchronously and assigns camX.value directly (no smoothing) so the very first rendered frame is already at the correct framing — verified by the [0,0,0,0,0,0] idle-vs-held tower delta.
No deprecated Expo packages present in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (expo-linear-gradient, expo-haptics, expo-status-bar, react-native-reanimated, react-native-safe-area-context are all current).

PlatformView reads platforms.value[index] each frame and returns opacity=0 + transform(-99999,-99999) for empty slots — this correctly hides pool overflow after cleanup. Observed screen-x=-61955 for these hidden slots in runs 8-10, which is exactly the expected 'parked' position, not a rendering bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 8 primary acceptance criteria (init x10 runs, starting-tower fixed position, warm-up, random maps, charge timing 50%@1s / 100%@2s / cap, immediate visual compression, no camera jump, physics regression)

seed_data_creation: None — best-score localStorage persisted between runs, verified best updates on new-high after landing.

rca_of_issue: N/A — verified the iteration's INITIALIZATION fix (gameReady state + guaranteed >=3 platforms in initWorld) and the improved visual charge compression (eased 0.14 + 0.86*c^0.7). Both changes are present, correct, and behave as specified across 10 consecutive runs. No regressions in physics, scoring, game-over, restart, or best-score persistence. FPS remained at 60.
